## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -4.13% | 1M: -4.35%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: -0.10% | 1M: +2.86%) CORRECTION alongside GLD (1W: +7.16% | 1M: +9.21%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND confirm mixed signals.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit mixed: HYG (1W: -0.05% | 1M: +0.47%) CORRECTION vs LQD (1W: -0.72% | 1M: -0.48%) BELOW TREND. Safe-haven bid and commodity strength: GLD (1W: +7.16% | 1M: +9.21%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +8.75% | 1M: +12.25%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-loosening. UUP (1W: -0.07% | 1M: -1.26%) BELOW TREND and TLT (1W: -0.76% | 1M: -1.73%) BELOW TREND show soft dollar and weaker long-duration demand, while SPY/TLT remains NEUTRAL overall.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Energy and materials leading: XLE (1W: +4.12% | 1M: +7.38%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and XME (1W: +9.24% | 1M: +15.42%) ABOVE TREND; Tech ETF XLK (1W: -0.43% | 1M: +2.65%) CORRECTION while Utilities XLU (1W: -1.09% | 1M: -4.57%) BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?
US showing resilience but soft near-term: SPY (1W: -0.10% | 1M: +2.86%) CORRECTION; China FXI (1W: -1.79% | 1M: +6.64%) CORRECTION and EEM (1W: -0.86% | 1M: +1.44%) CORRECTION show regional divergence with EM lagging.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Selective risk-on pockets: ARKK (1W: +9.38% | 1M: +0.24%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND and SKYY (1W: +4.99% | 1M: +15.07%) ABOVE TREND, while QQQ (1W: -0.75% | 1M: +0.94%) CORRECTION signals caution in broad tech exposure; IBIT (1W: +0.19% | 1M: +0.00%) NEUTRAL.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Precious metals and oil strong: GLD (1W: +7.16% | 1M: +9.21%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +8.75% | 1M: +12.25%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +10.78%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND. Copper CPER (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +6.01%) ABOVE TREND supports industrial demand signal.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy robust: XLE (1W: +4.12% | 1M: +7.38%) ABOVE TREND; natural gas UNG (1W: +3.07% | 1M: -2.89%) RECOVERY and remains vulnerable to mean reversion.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: multiple industry ETFs ABOVE TREND (XME, SKYY, XAR, BNO, GLD). MAJOR divergence present: SPY (1W: -0.10% | 1M: +2.86%), XLK (1W: -0.43% | 1M: +2.65%), XLF (1W: -0.14% | 1M: +3.09%) CORRECTION — short-week weakness vs month gains, so momentum is uneven.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclicals and commodity exposures showing strength: XLE (1W: +4.12% | 1M: +7.38%) ABOVE TREND, XME (1W: +9.24% | 1M: +15.42%) ABOVE TREND, GLD (1W: +7.16% | 1M: +9.21%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to short-term tech risk and defensive rate-sensitive names like XLK (1W: -0.43% | 1M: +2.65%) CORRECTION and XLU (1W: -1.09% | 1M: -4.57%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Energy XLE (1W: +4.12% | 1M: +7.38%) ABOVE TREND; Materials XME (1W: +9.24% | 1M: +15.42%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Utilities XLU (1W: -1.09% | 1M: -4.57%) BELOW TREND; Tech XLK (1W: -0.43% | 1M: +2.65%) CORRECTION.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Brent/Oil BNO (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +10.78%) ABOVE TREND; Silver SLV (1W: +8.75% | 1M: +12.25%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Solar TAN (1W: -1.26% | 1M: -0.79%) BELOW TREND; Natural gas UNG (1W: +3.07% | 1M: -2.89%) RECOVERY — watch for pullback.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 (complacency threshold); HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot); XLK/XLF spread 2.0 (growth vs value rotation trigger); GLD 1,900 area (safe-haven breakout watch).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, commodities and energy leading while risk indicators are mixed. Strength seen in XLE, XME and GLD; key risk is the MAJOR divergence between 1W softness in SPY/XLK/XLF and positive 1M gains — monitor momentum cross-checks.
